snippet.title: Neyyah – Release Date Announcement Trailer | Launching September 2nd
snippet.description:
Neyyah launches September 2nd.
Journey to a surreal archipelago inspired by classics like Myst and Riven, where every puzzle, portal, and strange machine brings you closer to uncovering a forgotten civilization’s secrets.

🎯 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1289720/Neyyah/

About the Game
Neyyah is a first-person point-and-click adventure game from Defy Reality Entertainment. Thrown into a strange, secretive world, you must use careful observation and logic to solve mind-bending puzzles, explore interconnected islands, and unravel the mysteries hidden within bizarre landscapes and cultures.
